commands.name: install
commands.summary: install a package from a source, a .pdpkg, a directory or a URL
commands.usage: pd install <包名|路径|URL> [--dry-run] [--as <名字>] [--sha256 <hex>] [--from-dir <目录>] [--source <源>] [--force] [--offline] [--refresh]

commands.name: fetch
commands.summary: download a package into the blob cache without installing it

commands.name: source
commands.usage: pd source list | add <名> <路径|URL|gh:owner/repo> [--kind dir|http|git] [--priority N] [--ttl dur] | remove <名> | enable|disable <名> | refresh [名]

commands.name: index
commands.summary: build an index from a directory or inspect an index file
commands.usage: pd index build <目录> [--out <文件>] [--name <源名>] [--priority N] | pd index inspect <文件|URL>
